draw.rule: per century: frame sorted by book_id, shuffled by Mulberry32(5924 + centuryStart); taken in that order until the target of books with a usable body leaf is met. Per book: leaves sorted by page_number, body = index [0.15·n, 0.9·n), body shuffled by Mulberry32(5924 ^ fnv1a(book_id)); the first 4 usable leaves (provider leaf URL, no split crop) are the candidates in order; the reader rejects non-text leaves and the next candidate is read.
